citation.authors: Choudhary D, Bhattacharyya S, Joshi K
citation.journal: Journal of Evidence-Based Complementary & Alternative Medicine

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: 52 adults under chronic stress (country and ethnicity not stated in the abstract)
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 300 mg root extract twice a day for 8 weeks
record.finding: Perceived stress, food cravings, eating behaviour, serum cortisol, body weight and BMI all improved compared with placebo. The extract was reported safe and tolerable.
record.note: Small. The size of the weight change is not in the abstract. Waist circumference was not reported.
